name: Yanagi Shin'ichirou
source:
Childhood friend of [url=/c5932]Hiroki[/url] and [url=/c5931]Kiri[/url]. His relationship with Hiroki went sour after Yanagi had stolen Hiroki’s composition of Kiri and then went on to win a national award with the painting. They do make up with each other later thanks to Kiri and [url=/c5933]Saya[/url].
He has a crush on Kiri and confesses to her when they are adults but Kiri turns him down. He then supports Kiri into confessing her feelings for Hiroki.
